# 00000003843

**English.** Definition: The 0-Hecke monoid H_n(0) is generated by monoid braid relations and absorption relations. Conjecture: The number of two-sided classes of H_n(0) is exactly the partition number p(n), and the number of left classes in each two-sided class equals the number of distinct hook lengths of the corresponding partition. (0-Hecke two-sided class-partition)

**中文。** 定义：0-Hecke 幺半群 H_n(0) 指由幺半群辫关系与吸收关系定义的生成幺半群。猜想：H_n(0) 的双边等价类个数恰为 n 的分拆数 p(n),且每个双边类含有的左等价类个数等于对应分拆的不同钩长个数。（0-Hecke 双边类-分拆）
